candidate_workaround: Split read-only probes, disable login-shell startup, and use a bounded window matched to the observed PowerShell startup envelope.
failure_signature: Two read-only ten-second probes expired before output while the local PowerShell startup envelope exceeded the requested bound.
recurrence_guard: Use decomposed login-disabled PowerShell probes with an explicit sixty-second ceiling when the measured startup envelope exceeds ten seconds.
rollback: Give both timed-out probes zero evidence credit and make no repository or host-state claim from them.
scope_boundary: Same-owner read-only shell-probe recovery only; not a performance guarantee, host certification, or independent reproduction.
title: Bound PowerShell startup probes to the measured envelope
trigger_preconditions: a read-only PowerShell probe has a ten-second bound
local startup overhead is not yet characterized
